Un nodulo polmonare è un'opacità rotonde: A pulmonary nodule is a round opacity up to 3 cm (above that it is called a mass). First look for previous X-rays: a nodule stable for more than 2 years or with benign calcification (central, diffuse, «popcorn», laminated) needs nothing else. Otherwise it is characterised by CT, which gives size, density (solid, part-solid, ground glass) and margins; the next steps follow the guidelines (Fleischner for incidental nodules) and the patient's risk. Beware of mimics: nipple, rib crossings, osteophytes, costal cartilage calcification.
Davanti a un nodulo: cerca le RX precede: Faced with a nodule: look for previous X-rays, then CT; exclude nipples and rib crossings.
